title: Recreatiebehoefte onderzoek arnhem-zuid 1981
authors: Vries, A. de, Provincie Gelderland * Arnhem, Dienst ruimtelijke ordening en volkshuisvesting (primary investigator)
contributors: Nederlandse stichting voor statistiek, NSS * Den Haag (data collector)
descriptions: Recreation needs of the population on the outskirts of Arnhem-Zuid, Elst and Huissen. Use of the recreational areas between arnhem-zuid, elst and huissen / wishes for greater variety of recreational facilities / accessibility of the area by car, bicycle, public transport / most important recreational activities of respondent. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics
